_howTo: School competitions held at Albayan. To add a new one, copy the Idiom Day block, change the id, text, video and winners, then point data/featured.json at the new id.

items.title: Idiom Day 2026
items.excerpt: Students dressed up as their favorite idioms. Meet the best-costume winners from every grade!
items.body:
Dress it. Show it. Be the idiom! On Idiom Day, our students came to school dressed as their favorite English and Arabic idioms — from a piece of cake to a smart cookie.

Congratulations to our winners from every grade, and thank you to everyone who took part!
items.organizers: Miss Najla Al-Thani & Miss Salma Jaber, English Department
